title: Asadora!
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In 1959 Nagoya, overlooked Asa Asada, one of eleven children, runs for a doctor while her mother is in labor and is kidnapped by a jobless former fighter pilot who mistakes her for a doctor's child. When a deadly typhoon devastates the city, the two team up to bring food and water to stranded survivors, and hints of a giant creature appear; a frame story shows a monster attacking Tokyo in 2020 (VIZ blurb via AniList; ANN review).
life_message: Ordinary people, even forgotten children and discarded veterans, find purpose by stepping up for others in a crisis.

content.note: A kidnapping and war background (ANN); AniList War; no graphic violence noted.
Typhoon Vera's destruction of Nagoya (ANN); AniList Natural Disaster, Tragedy, Kaiju.

folkways.japan: Set against postwar recovery and the 1959 typhoon, it reflects Japanese memories of rebuilding and the ambivalent place of former soldiers.

delivery.evidence: ANN finds themes of people coming together and veterans' lost purpose in the story's events; no lecturing noted.
delivery.note: Its view of community and recovery is carried by rescue scenes rather than speeches.

winners_losers: Asa and the pilot gain purpose by helping survivors; the typhoon's victims are the losers. Sympathy goes to the overlooked (later arcs to verify).
